title: Data Engineer
description:
About Mirakl:
 Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.
Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).
With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.
 For more information: www.mirakl.com .
 Mirakl in Numbers:
 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
 ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions
 Our Values:
 Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.
 Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:
 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

title: Senior Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Senior Data Engineer (m/w/d)
 Standort: Dresden
 Start: Ab sofort
 Unternehmensprofil
 Das Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz in München ist ein global agierender Anbieter von Lösungen in den Bereichen Elektro-, Test- und Messtechnik sowie Kommunikationstechnologie. Das Unternehmen bietet ein breites Spektrum an Produkten, darunter Testgeräte für Elektronik, Funkkommunikation, Satellitenkommunikation und Netzwerke. Diese Produkte werden von Unternehmen in verschiedenen Branchen eingesetzt, darunter Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Telekommunikation, Automobilindustrie und Elektronik.
 Aufgaben
 Konzeption und Entwicklung einer On-Premises-Datenplattform
 Entwicklung und Integration von Komponenten für Datenorchestrierung, Deployment und Plattformautomatisierung
 Implementierung von Batch- und Streaming-Datenpipelines sowie plattformbezogenen Services
 Integration von Workloads auf Kubernetes sowie S3-kompatiblen Storage-Lösungen
 Untersuchung von Datenkatalogen und Datenversionierung sowie deren Integration in die Plattform
 Zusammenarbeit mit Lead Architekten sowie Infrastruktur- und Security-Teams
 Qualifikationen
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
 Freude an Proofs of Concept, die eigenständig zum Laufen gebracht werden
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und Kubernetes-Infrastruktur sowie mit Linux-Betriebssystemen
 Kenntnisse moderner Datenplattform-Architekturen wie Kappa oder Medallion sowie Batch- und Low-Latency-Streaming-Pipelines
 Praktische Kenntnisse in Python, Golang, SQL (MPP), Bash und Java
 Routinierter Umgang mit Linux, Linux-Containern und Kubernetes (Cloud Native) sowie eigene Ideen für Data-Management-Plattformen am Edge ohne Public-Cloud-Services
 Idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Data Scientist
 Analytisches Denken, agiles Mindset, ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und starke Lösungsorientierung
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 Zusätzliche Informationen & Benefits

title: Data Engineer, Marketplace
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Here at Lyft, data is at the core of every decision we make. It powers our business — helping us create great transportation experiences for our customers and providing insights into the effectiveness of our product launches and features.
 As a Data Engineer on Lyft’s Marketplace – Decision Apps team, you will own and evolve the data pipelines that power our top-line financial, pricing, and driver-related metrics. You will collaborate with Analytics, Data Science, and Engineering partners to design data models and architectures — proposing innovative ideas, evaluating multiple approaches, and implementing solutions grounded in fundamental engineering principles and rigorous data analysis. Your work will provide seamless access to the insights that drive Lyft’s success.
 Responsibilities:
 Take ownership of core data pipelines, ensuring resilience, optimal performance, timely delivery, data quality, and seamless onboarding of new features
 Continuously evolve data models and schemas to meet business and engineering requirements
 Implement and maintain systems to monitor and enhance data quality and consistency
 Develop tools that support self-service management of data pipelines (ETL) and perform SQL tuning to optimize data processing performance
 Contribute to the Data Engineering team’s technical roadmap, ensuring alignment with team and stakeholder goals
 Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, prioritizing scalability and cost efficiency
 Conduct code reviews to uphold code quality standards and facilitate knowledge sharing
 Participate in on-call rotations to maintain high availability and reliability of workflows and data pipelines
 Collaborate with internal and external partners to remove blockers, provide support, and achieve results
 Experience:
 5+ years of professional experience…

title: Data Engineer (Databricks, Snowflake)
description:
For one of our clients, we are looking for an Advanced Data Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines and data products. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs and turn diverse data sources into reliable, reusable datasets.
 Design, develop, test and monitor distributed data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads.
 Integrate structured and unstructured data and produce reproducible datasets that meet the needs of data consumers.
 Advise clients on technical options and explain design decisions to technical and business stakeholders.
 Work with architects, software engineers and data scientists to deliver data products iteratively.
 Degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a comparable qualification.
 At least three years of experience in data engineering or software engineering.
 Practical Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases.
 Experience building and maintaining data products, with knowledge of architectures such as data lakes, lakehouses and medallion architectures.
 Experience with cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or Amazon SageMaker.
 Familiarity with large-scale data processing, data analysis and visualisation, as well as agile development and DevOps.
 Hands-on experience with or interest in technologies such as Spark, Delta Lake, Airflow, Kafka, Kubernetes or Terraform.
 Fluent German and English.

title: Big Data Engineer
description:
For one of our clients, we are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design data architectures and build distributed pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. Your work will make data ready for operational use, analytics and machine learning.
 Design and maintain scalable data architectures and pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments.
 Integrate diverse data sources and ensure processing is reliable and reproducible.
 Test and monitor distributed pipelines and estimate performance and costs for different use cases.
 Collaborate with data scientists to prepare datasets for machine learning and build dashboards that make processed data accessible to users.
 Degree in computer science, mathematics or a related field.
 Several years of experience in technical roles, with strong Python and SQL skills and a focus on maintainable software.
 Sound knowledge of big data infrastructure, scalable databases and distributed processing.
 Good understanding of public cloud services such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
 Experience with or interest in tools such as Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Airflow or Kubernetes, and familiarity with relational or NoSQL databases and DevOps practices.
 Fluent German and English.

title: Staff Data Engineer, Advanced Insights & Modeling
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
 The Role
 The Advanced Insights and Modeling (AIM) team is a high-impact, business-savvy group of builders: machine learning engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business strategists who combine technical skills with deep product and financial expertise. We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non-corporate. Teams across Block come to us when they need insight, speed, and real business impact.
 AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance. We own most of the measurement and predictive modeling at Block: forecasting across Cash App, Square, and Afterpay, customer lifetime value, marketing incrementality and spend optimization, sales pipeline and prospect value, and actives and network-effect measurement. description:

 What you get
 Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
 We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
 Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
 No micromanagement, no screen trackers
 Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
 Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries
 Who we’re looking for
 Senior Data Engineers with:
 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer
 Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required
